purpose: Define model families, training objectives, labels, datasets, and blocked outputs for PARALLAX feeder-to-authority intelligence.

modelFamilies.job: Classify feeder repo artifacts into allowed, review_required, internal_only, or blocked records.
Evaluate agent commands, HFT signals, cloud exports, and connector actions against alpha boundaries.
Route a valid use case to wallet, native, edge, proof-room, research, cloud, or governance surfaces.
Produce receipt-ready records from approved paper/testnet events and feeder classifications.

trainingBoundaries: Do not train models to produce live execution instructions during alpha.
Do not include secrets, API keys, wallet keys, private user data, or raw private memory in datasets.
Do not turn feeder content into authority without source repo, lane, classification, and target surface.
Do not label notarization, receipt, or hash records as proof of truth, legal ownership, performance, or regulatory approval.
All training examples must preserve paper/testnet-first language unless future readiness gates explicitly exist.
